A hotfix for v3.0.0: the app could fail to render with a server error on every page.

## Fixed

- **App failed to render (HTTP 500 on every route).** The Mantine theme module
  was marked client-only but is used during server rendering, so every page
  threw a `TypeError` while rendering. The theme is now built correctly on the
  server. If you ran v3.0.0 and saw a blank or error page, update to v3.0.1 and
  it will load again. A regression test now guards against it.
